list.title: My characters
list.intro: Your character sheets, reusable across your campaigns.
list.loadFailed: Could not load your characters. Check your connection.
list.deleteText: This sheet will be lost for good. If it was chosen in a campaign, you will have to pick another one — and the Game Master will have to add you back to the adventures in progress.
list.emptyText: Create a sheet to join a campaign as a player.
list.draftHint: Finish it before you can play it.

detail.draft: This character is still a draft: its sheet can't be computed until creation is finished.

load.notYours: This sheet doesn't belong to you.
load.levelUpOnlyDnd: The guided level-up is for finished 5E (2024) sheets.
load.rebuildOnlyDnd: This path is for finished 5E (2024) sheets.

dnd2024.tagline: The fifth edition's core rules. The sheet works everything out for you.
dnd2024.about: Your character follows the fifth edition's core rules (SRD 5.2.1). Hit points, armor class, skill bonuses, spells: the sheet does the maths and keeps it up to date as the character grows.
dnd2024.note: Each screen asks a single question and explains what it is for. Allow a quarter of an hour the first time. The creation is saved on this device, and you can save it as a draft at any time.

standard.tagline: A free-form sheet, for any game. Nothing is calculated.
standard.about: You write down what matters at your table, with no rules imposed: you stay in control of every value. Ideal for another roleplaying game, or a character passing through.
standard.note: A single form, filled in in a few minutes and editable at any time.

class.title: Class
class.text: Your role in the group, then your name, your level and the class's own choices.

species.title: Species
species.text: Your people, their traits and the options they offer.

background.title: Background
background.text: What you did before adventuring, your alignment and your languages.

abilities.title: Ability scores
abilities.text: Your six scores, then the bonuses your background gives you.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.text: Your pack, a few purchases, then a review of the whole sheet.

identity.title: Identity
identity.text: The name, maximum hit points, a colour and an image.

notes.title: Notes
notes.text: Anything you want to remember about the character.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.text: The items they carry, with their quantities.

create.resumed: Your creation is back: confirm it to save it to your account.
create.inProgress: A 5E creation is in progress on this device
create.title: New character
create.intro: Start by choosing your character's rules: they decide what the sheet holds and what it calculates.
create.guestDnd: No account needed to try: the creation stays on this device, with the core rules. You will be asked for an account to save the character.
create.guestStandard: The free-form sheet is saved straight to your account: sign in or create an account to fill it in.
create.srdAlways: The core rules (SRD 5.2.1) are always included.
create.tickPacks: Tick the packs whose species, backgrounds, subclasses, feats and spells the creation can offer.
create.addPacks: Add packs to your library to offer other species, backgrounds or feats.

errors.name: Name required.
errors.base: Fill in the 6 ability scores (or “Suggested scores”).
errors.baseRange: Each ability score must be between 1 and 30.
errors.invocations: At most {{count}} eldritch invocation(s) at this level.
errors.masteries: At most {{count}} weapon mastery(ies) at this level.

equipment.armorsHint: Full form; tick “equipped” on the armor and/or shield worn — the AC is recalculated.
equipment.ownedToolsHint: The item in your bag. Owning it doesn't mean knowing how to use it — that's the proficiency, just above.
equipment.inventoryHint: Works like weapons/armor: full form + prefill from the list.

fields.focus: A focus is for casting spells: no attack, no property.

components.v: Verbal: cast out loud — impossible if gagged or in an area of Silence.
components.s: Somatic: a sweeping gesture, with a free hand.
components.m: Material: a specific component, or a spellcasting focus in its place.

spellCard.noSave: Takes the effect, no saving throw
spellCard.ritual: Ritual: can be cast without a slot (+10 minutes of casting).
spellCard.notRitual: Can't be cast as a ritual.

standardForm.intro: Standard sheet: name, image, colour, hit points and inventory.
standardForm.name: Name
standardForm.notesPlaceholder: Everything that matters for this character…

invocations.pickCantripAttack: First choose a cantrip (with an attack roll)
invocations.pickCantripDamage: First choose a cantrip (that deals damage)
invocations.title: Eldritch invocations
invocations.intro: Permanent improvements or at-will spells unique to the warlock. The number known and the choices available depend on the level; the Pacts open further invocations. Their numeric effects (AC, vision, calculator bonuses…) apply automatically.
invocations.addWeaponFirst: First add a melee weapon (Weapons section) to designate it.
invocations.pactWeaponHint: It attacks with your Charisma and you are proficient with it; it also gets Lifedrinker.
invocations.cantripAttack: Choose one of your warlock cantrips with an attack roll.
invocations.cantripDamage: Choose one of your warlock cantrips that deals damage.

toolProficiencies.title: Tool proficiencies
toolProficiencies.intro: Knowing how to use the tool: you add your proficiency bonus to checks that involve it. Owning the item is another matter — it goes under “Tools owned”, below.
toolProficiencies.granted: Granted by the class and the background, plus your choices

features.subclassPending: Subclass features are not detailed here yet.
features.ownWords: Summaries in our own words. See the rulebook for the full text.

hp.finalWarning: This choice is final: as soon as you take the average, roll the die or confirm your roll, the other two options lock.
hp.chooseOne: Choose how you gain your hit points.

mastery.title: Weapon masteries ({{picked}}/{{count}})
mastery.intro: Choose the kinds of weapon whose mastery property you use, carried or not. Only the weapons your class is proficient with are offered.

story.title: Title
story.campaignRequired: Pick the campaign to share with.

visibilityHints.gm: This campaign's GM reads it; the other players don't.
visibilityHints.party: Every member of this campaign reads it, the GM included.

story.noCampaign: This character plays in no campaign: only you can read it.

personality.title: Personality
personality.intro: What drives your character, in a few words.
personality.traitsPlaceholder: Always a quip, even at the worst moment.
personality.bondsPlaceholder: I will find my missing brother.
personality.flawsPlaceholder: I can never resist a wager.

chapters.title: Chapters of the past
chapters.intro: Your character's past, chapter by chapter. The sheet's backstory stays its prologue.

journal.title: Journal
journal.intro: What your character lived, from their point of view. Write after a session from the adventure's chronicle, or freely here.

shared.noChapter: Nothing shared with the party yet.
shared.noEntry: No journal entry shared with the party.
